scope: Interpretation only. Do not edit or regenerate the executed report; no artifacts were reopened and no calculations were run.

actual_joined_ancestry_events.note: These are `joined_ancestry_to_selected_candidate_events` values, not the comparison-field counts.

transport_bit_comparisons.left_censored_prefix_formula: 69 joined earlier-VFT events x 4 transported fields (adjusted VNU, SP, SPPSP, RECALF)
transport_bit_comparisons.dominant_formula: 12 ancestry-to-phase3 field comparisons (3 x 4) plus 15 same-call phase2 field comparisons (3 x 5)

legacy_report_keys.dominant_same_call_bit_checks: Misleading label for the prefix group: its 276 count is earlier-VFT-to-selected-phase3 transport checks. For the dominant group its 27 count also includes 12 ancestry-to-phase3 comparisons and 15 same-call comparisons.
legacy_report_keys.matched_event_count: Counts successful per-field transport comparisons (276 prefix; 12 dominant), not source ancestry events. Use joined_ancestry_to_selected_candidate_events for event counts.

result_scope: Counts describe the saved-data reader's exact source-field joins. They do not establish original AER ASCII/TAPE3 coefficient correctness, absolute initial SUI (WKL/WKI amounts unavailable), or physical validity of negative optical depth.
